name: Arcee Industries Limited
about: Arcee Industries Limited manufactures and sells rigid PVC and steel pipes in India. It offers its products for various applications, such as rural and urban water distribution systems; agriculture irrigation; protective for power and communication cables; air vent systems for toxic gas; bore well casing and suction pipes; relining of old sewers; surface water drainages; horticultural and green house technologies; internal plumbing water and wastewater supplier for domestic and industrial purposes; and chemical, sugar, and dairy industrial use. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Hisar, India.
